title: VR Live Events
desc: Plan and run a live virtual-reality or virtual event: platforms, access, moderation, safety and measures of success.
outcomes: Prepare tech checks and run sheets.
task: Plan and run a 30-minute virtual event for 10 to 20 people, with rehearsal, moderation, accessibility, feedback and report.
condition: Computers or VR headsets as available, a free event platform, two peers and a mentor.
standard: Rehearsal passes; moderation rules enforced; accessibility options present; feedback from 80% of attendees; report with data; peers rate Meets or better.
who: Event planners, teachers, community groups, trainers.
evidence: plan, run sheet, tech checklist, feedback report
modules: A training uses desktop for easy access.
A fallback video link saves a failed session.
Code of conduct; block, mute, report.
Age rules; no personal data sharing.
A harasser is muted and removed.
Attendance, time in event, feedback scores.
quiz: Name a format.
Desktop 3D, headset VR or hybrid. (Covered in module 1: Formats. To pass that module: Table.)
Why a fallback?
Protect the session. (Covered in module 2: Goals and audience. To pass that module: Measurable.)
Code of conduct use?
Set behaviour rules. (Covered in module 3: Tech check. To pass that module: Ten items.)
Motion sickness fix?
Teleport movement or breaks. (Covered in module 4: Moderation and safety. To pass that module: Clear.)
Time zone issue?
Choose fair times. (Covered in module 5: Access. To pass that module: Measures listed.)
Metric?
Attendance or rating. (Covered in module 6: Run sheet and rehearsal. To pass that module: Fixes logged.)
Roles?
Host, tech, moderator. (Covered in module 7: Live run. To pass that module: Mentor observes.)
Rehearsals?
At least two. (Covered in module 8: Measure and report. To pass that module: Numbers real.)
Privacy?
No personal data sharing. (Covered in module 8: Measure and report. To pass that module: Numbers real.)
Access feature?
Captions. (Covered in module 8: Measure and report. To pass that module: Numbers real.)
rubric: Every claim linked to a dated record and checked by a peer
Checked, dated and explained to others
next: holographic theatre, podcasting, social network building.
local: Privacy and child-protection rules differ by place.
ladder: Formats

L1: learner can name formats. Focus module: Formats (Understand, 3 h). Choose the right space. Key points: Desktop 3D, headset VR, hybrid streams. Social, training, concert, expo. Capacity and comfort.

Teach: open with the worked example. A training uses desktop for easy access. Then set the activity: Compare formats. Mark against the standard: Table. Check at this level: Name a format. Model answer: Desktop 3D, headset VR or hybrid. Formats.
Goals and audience
L2: learner knows safety. Focus module: Goals and audience (Create, 3 h). Set outcomes. Key points: One goal with a number. Know devices people have. Plan for low bandwidth.

Teach: open with the worked example. 80 attendees, 70% stay to the end. Then set the activity: Write goals. Mark against the standard: Measurable. Check at this level: Why a fallback? Model answer: Protect the session. Safety.
Tech check
L3: learner can check tech. Focus module: Tech check (Apply, 4 h). Avoid surprises. Key points: Accounts, links, audio, avatars, backups. Test on each device. Helper desk.

Teach: open with the worked example. A fallback video link saves a failed session. Then set the activity: Make a checklist. Mark against the standard: Ten items. Check at this level: Code of conduct use? Model answer: Set behaviour rules. Check.
Moderation and safety

L4: learner can run a session. Focus module: Moderation and safety (Evaluate, 4 h). Safe space. Key points: Code of conduct; block, mute, report. Age rules; no personal data sharing. Moderators trained.

Teach: open with the worked example. A harasser is muted and removed. Then set the activity: Write rules. Mark against the standard: Clear. Check at this level: Motion sickness fix? Model answer: Teleport movement or breaks. Run.
Access
L5: learner can analyse. Focus module: Access (Evaluate, 4 h). Everyone in. Key points: Captions, transcripts, keyboard options. Motion-sickness settings. Time zones and breaks.

Teach: open with the worked example. Teleport movement reduces sickness. Then set the activity: Write an access plan. Mark against the standard: Measures listed. Check at this level: Time zone issue? Model answer: Choose fair times. Data.
Live run
L6: learner can lead. Focus module: Live run (Create, 4 h). Run it. Key points: Welcome, rules, content, Q&A, close. Handle problems calmly. Collect feedback.

Teach: open with the worked example. Pilot finishes on time. Then set the activity: Run the pilot. Mark against the standard: Mentor observes. Check at this level: Metric? Model answer: Attendance or rating. Lead.
Measure and report
L7: learner can audit. Focus module: Measure and report (Analyse, 3 h). Learn. Key points: Attendance, time in event, feedback scores. Fix top issues. Share results.

Teach: open with the worked example. Average rating 4.3. Then set the activity: Write a report. Mark against the standard: Numbers real. Check at this level: Roles? Model answer: Host, tech, moderator. Peer audit.
